name: Grasshopper Locust Load Testing Framework
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 Python framework for local API load testing using Locust and pytest, with scenario configuration, checks, latency thresholds, custom trends and metrics integrations; no software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires Python, Locust and pytest setup plus your own load-generation compute. Optional InfluxDB or Datadog metrics backends and hosted CI infrastructure may incur charges; no hosted load-testing capacity is included.
